desc: Ideation complete: derive cyclic-shift sweep and per-value wrap delta approach.

Implement the sweep solution in Python: read N, M, A; compute initial inversion count for k=0 with a Fenwick tree; precompute delta[v] for each value v using the positional wrap formula; sweep k=0..M-1 printing current answer and updating with delta[(M-1-k) mod M].
Verify the delta formula handles duplicate values, same-value pairs, and non-wrapping elements correctly; include M=1 and N=1 edge cases.
If the positional formula is uncertain, implement or cross-check an explicit delta computation using sorted position lists and counts of non-wrapping elements before/after each wrapping position.
Test against provided samples and edge cases: all equal, strictly increasing, strictly decreasing, empty position lists.
